dct_title_s: Satellite detected water extent over Bulo Burto City, Bulo Burto District, Hiraan Region of Somalia as of 30 May 2023
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code FL20230327SOM, GDACS Id: 1101908** This map illustrates satellite-detected surface waters over Bulo Burto City, Bulo Burto District, Hiraan Region of Somalia as observed from a Pleiades image acquired on 29 and 30 May 2023. Within the analysed area of 20 km², about 2 km² of land appear to be flooded. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
